items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide. Risk is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, and medium for bounded reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown. No certificate is reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS safety. Exact decision: block public exposure and security-sensitive releases; permit only bounded reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix without duplicate work, credential access, private-container access, permission changes, deployment, exploitation, or outreach.

Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate work or access credentials, private containers, permissions, configuration, dependencies, deployments, exploit targets, or external outreach.
